principles.currency: Dataset-native commerce currency. Do not relabel as MYR/USD unless explicitly transformed.
principles.runtime_truth: Metrics are defined against canonical/effective runtime views, not hidden evaluation ground truth.
principles.agent_access: Agent-facing tools may access canonical and semantic schemas only; staging is forbidden.
principles.causality: A metric change is evidence of an outcome, not proof of cause. Causes require hypothesis testing.

metrics.business_definition: Effective recognized commerce revenue after runtime operational overrides and controlled incremental marketing effects.
known_limitations: Synthetic incident mechanics are controlled evaluation layers built on top of real Olist transactions.
Revenue movement alone must not be interpreted as profitable growth.

metrics.business_definition: Effective contribution profit after modeled revenue recognition, COGS, acquisition spend, and campaign incentive costs represented in the runtime data world.
known_limitations: Not equivalent to accounting net income.
Only modeled variable economics represented in the dataset are included.

metrics.business_definition: Effective contribution profit divided by effective recognized revenue.
metrics.grain: ratio of sums at order-level source
known_limitations: Should be recomputed as a ratio of sums when aggregating, not averaged across rows.
Fraction from 0 to 1; multiply by 100 only when displaying percent.

metrics.business_definition: Distinct commerce orders represented in the effective runtime world.
known_limitations: Operational incidents may alter recognized revenue without deleting the underlying raw order.

metrics.business_definition: Share of canonical GA4 sessions containing at least one purchase event.
known_limitations: GA4 public sample is obfuscated and belongs to a separate behavioral environment from Olist.
Do not join GA4 users directly to Olist customers.

metrics.business_definition: Share of sessions that began checkout but recorded no purchase.
known_limitations: Only sessions with begin_checkout are in the denominator.
Cross-midnight GA4 sessions were consolidated before loading.

metrics.business_definition: Controlled modeled revenue not recognized because affected products were unavailable during the stockout evaluation window.
known_limitations: This is a modeled controlled evaluation metric, not directly observed lost demand.

metrics.business_definition: Observed review score adjusted by controlled CX incident effects where applicable.
known_limitations: Review text/title missingness in Olist remains substantial.
Average score alone should not replace distributional analysis.
